epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫妮卡加勒蒂由出身卑微晉升到在世界最苛刻廚房之一工作，這是非凡故事。她跟隨米歇爾魯學習廚藝十多年，她的才華和對廚藝的熱愛使她從三廚晉升為店主兼主廚，她在倫敦開設第一家餐廳，並以她母親Mere的名字命名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monica Galetti's story of a chef's rise from humble beginnings to cooking in one of the most demanding kitchens in the world is exceptional. A protégé of Michel Roux Jr for over a decade, her talent and devotion to her craft has taken her from commis to chef patron, with the opening of her first London restaurant, named after her mother, Mere.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬納森帶著剛考得潛水牌的扎克到緬因州, 認識著名狼魚夫婦阿博和阿珍. 原來阿珍尤其愛吃青蟹, 簡直有助控制青蟹的數目. 接著攝製隊前往科蘇梅爾島探索洞穴, 那洞穴住著全世界極獨特及罕見的洞穴動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jonathan takes his newly-scuba certified cameraman Zach to northern Maine to meet a famous Atlantic wolffish couple named Bob and Jane. Jane is particularly fond of green crabs. This helps control the population of green crabs. Then the crew travel to Cozumel to explore a cave containing some of the most unique and rare cave fauna in the world.

Only two of the seven planned youth hostels have been completed since the plan was launched in 2011. We examine the reasons behind the delay in the project to provide housing for young people. And in recent years, many hotels are being converted into youth hostel to alleviate the rising demand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔斯曼尼亞是澳洲的海島州，與澳洲大陸隔了一個巴斯海峽，有大片不受人為破壞的原野，是個隱世寶藏。島上有雄偉的山嶺、高聳入雲的森林、壯麗的海岸線、原始的河溪、最清潔的空氣和水。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasmania is an island state of Australia. Separated from the mainland by the Bass Strait, it is a hidden treasure renowned for its clean, green environment and unspoilt beauty, with stunning mountain ranges, tall forests, dramatic coastline and pristine rivers, and some of the cleanest air and water on the planet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 占美奧利華重回廚神廚房, 給家廚極具挑戰性的任務. 他們要爭奪這季度首個豁免權挑戰賽的兩個席位. 在第一回合, 他們要在15分鐘煮出美食. 由於時限短, 壓力極大. 最終, 5位參賽者打入第二回合.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Jamie Oliver has returned with two difficult challenges for our home cooks. They cook for one of the two places in the very first immunity challenge of this season. In Round 1, Jamie tasks the contestants to cook a delicious dish in 15 minutes. Nerves are high due to limited time. In the end, 5 contestants make it to Round 2.

epg.programme_title_tc: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在第二回合, 參賽者要效率更快. 他們跟隨占美奧利華炮製意式捲餅. 這道菜對他們很陌生, 對占美卻很特別. 他訴說它如何令他首次亮相電視,教人感動. 我們看到他們如何步步緊貼他. 過程緊湊而有趣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Round 2, the contestants are asked to work faster than Round 1. They need to keep up with Jamie Oliver as he makes a Rotolo. This dish is alien to them. However, it is special for Jamie. He recounts how he made it for his first television appearance. It's very touching. We see how the contestants follow Jamie in all the steps. And the process is intense yet interesting.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集，我們將在帛琉的藍角與一群令人驚嘆的鯊魚一起潛水。然後我們前往科羅拉多州丹佛市一個令人驚嘆的水族館，近距離觀察幾種鯊魚，並展示鯊魚如何適應這個高海拔水族館。最後，我們深入探討白斑角鯊的特性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we dive with an amazing array of sharks at Palau's Blue Corner. And then we go to Denver, Colorado, to an amazing aquarium for a close up look at several species of sharks and show how sharks adapt in this High-Altitude Aquarium. Lastly, we take a Deeper Dive with Spiny Dogfish Sharks.

She also finds out about some of the things that the team does to protect the wildlife in the area.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabon emerges as a land of wild contrasts, where palm-fringed beaches, vast mangroves, primal forests and open savannahs shape daily life. From markets, fishing villages and forest rituals to rice fields, sacred landscapes and national parks rich with gorillas, elephants and marine life, the journey reveals a country in transition, striving to protect its traditions, wildlife and fragile natural heritage.

Introducing exhilarating sessions like the Canine Crime Files; What's That Dog Barking at Now?; Animal News Network, and many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集來到新英格蘭，這兒在1770年代見證美國誕生，以有白色尖塔教堂的古老村莊和歷史名城波士頓聞名。我們會探討新英格蘭成立的歷史，欣賞殖民地式建築和獨特燈塔，並回顧美國獨立戰爭的第一響槍聲如何在此響起。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A region that witnessed the birth of a new nation in the 1770s, famous for its old villages with white-steepled churches, as well as the historic city of Boston. We are in New England, USA. Delve into the history of it's founding, admire the beauty of its Colonial-style buildings, explore its distinctive lighthouses, and learn how the first shots of the American War of Independence were fired here.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很多地方都有標誌性的遷徙動物. 牠們穿梭很遠距離, 面對生關死劫. 稀樹草原的畜群引來肉食動物, 由鱷魚到獅子都有. 海裡也一樣. 無數沙丁魚追逐隨冷水而來的養份, 自己卻淪為捕食者的瘋狂進食對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode focuses on the iconic, migratory animals of various places. They travel vast distances and battle extreme odds of survival. Giant herds of the savannah attract all kinds of carnivores ranging from crocodiles to lions. It is the same in the sea. Millions of sardines chase the cold, nutrient rich upwellings, only to find themselves in a feeding frenzy of ocean predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫妮卡加勒蒂由出身卑微晉升到在世界最苛刻廚房之一工作，這是非凡故事。她跟隨米歇爾魯學習廚藝十多年，她的才華和對廚藝的熱愛使她從三廚晉升為店主兼主廚，她在倫敦開設第一家餐廳，並以她母親Mere的名字命名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monica Galetti's story of a chef's rise from humble beginnings to cooking in one of the most demanding kitchens in the world is exceptional. A protégé of Michel Roux Jr for over a decade, her talent and devotion to her craft has taken her from commis to chef patron, with the opening of her first London restaurant, named after her mother, Mere.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集，我們從熱鬧的街邊小食檔走到家庭經營餐館，再到當地巿場，品嘗牛肉河粉、烤肉榨粉等美食，了解歷史文化對河內美食的影響。還有兩位大廚會分享烹飪技巧和個人歷程，並了解越南沒有米芝蓮餐廳的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, moving from bustling street-food stalls to family-run kitchens and local markets, we sample specialties such as pho, bun cha, and regional delicacies while learning how history, geography, and culture shape Hanoi's cuisine. Along the way, we meet passionate cooks who share their techniques and personal journeys. And we learn the reasons there's no Michelin Guide restaruants in Vietnam.

epg.programme_title_en: WEATHER REPORT[Eng] and Top 100 National Dishes[Eng]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿畢和巴尼來到市川，向日本飄移傳奇西田羅比請教飄移技術。然後挑戰日本持有二十項健力士世界紀錄的男士。之後他們參觀河內長野市的勝光寺，嘗試冥想和冰凍瀑布鍛煉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bradley and Barney arrive in Ichikawa to take a lesson from Japanese drifting legend Robbie Nishida. After that, they challenge Japan's number one record holder who holds twenty Guinness world records. Then they visit the Shokoji Temple in the city of Kawachinagano, where they meditate and sample some ice-cold waterfall training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加州包羅萬有. 金門大橋曾是全球最高及最長橋樑, 還有全球最彎曲街道：倫巴底街. 餐廳及美食車眾多. 你可感受海濱城市及標誌景點的神秘氛圍, 探索酒吧餐廳、細味朱古力、汽車文化和葡萄酒項目.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: California has it all. The Golden Gate Bridge was once the tallest and longest bridge in the world. It also has the crookedest street in the world: the Lombard Street. Famous restaurants and food trucks are numerous. You can experience seaside cities, dive into the mystique of California locations, explore bars and restaurants, taste chocolate, car culture, and passion wine projects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬納森帶著剛考得潛水牌的扎克到緬因州, 認識著名狼魚夫婦阿博和阿珍. 原來阿珍尤其愛吃青蟹, 簡直有助控制青蟹的數目. 接著攝製隊前往科蘇梅爾島探索洞穴, 那洞穴住著全世界極獨特及罕見的洞穴動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jonathan takes his newly-scuba certified cameraman Zach to northern Maine to meet a famous Atlantic wolffish couple named Bob and Jane. Jane is particularly fond of green crabs. This helps control the population of green crabs. Then the crew travel to Cozumel to explore a cave containing some of the most unique and rare cave fauna in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隋煬帝時代，新羅裔天子虯髯客為償其父逐鹿中原之願，率新羅國勇士，微服親赴中原，一探究竟。李靖胸懷大志，本欲投效朝廷，卻見腐敗，傷心之餘，遇紅拂女二人產生戀情。虯髯客至中原巧救紅拂女，虯髯客心生情愫。
一場車禍令張曉夢見自己與四爺曾經的刻骨銘心之戀。醒來時， 夢中碎片般的畫面令張曉一直緊緊於懷。一次偶遇，張曉遇見夢中的四爺，發現他原來是震天集團董事長康震天的繼子殷正…
柳重言是京城第一狀師柳繼先之子，他有些玩世不恭，但才智超群，最愛打抱不平，他不願沾父親的光，發誓要全憑自己如簧巧舌，如刀之筆，扶危濟困，終於成為狀師界的頭名，被稱為天下第一狀師。

正直果敢的唐周在下山歷練途中偶遇同樣懷有鋤強扶弱的少女顏淡和她的好友余墨，三人結伴同行。之後唐周與舊識柳維楊重逢，並得知有惡勢力盤踞之地，眾人共赴秘境探險。
正直果敢的唐周在下山歷練途中偶遇同樣懷有鋤強扶弱的少女顏淡和她的好友余墨，三人結伴同行。之後唐周與舊識柳維楊重逢，並得知有惡勢力盤踞之地，眾人共赴秘境探險。
講述地球基礎科學研究遭遇異常擾動，引發科學界惶恐動盪，納米物理學家汪淼與刑警史強聯手調查，共同揭開了地外未知文明“三體”世界的神秘面紗，並隨全人類一道與即將入侵的三體人展開博弈的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story of an abnormal disturbance in basic scientific research on the earth, which caused panic and turmoil in the scientific community. Nanophysicist Wang Miao and criminal policeman Shi Qiang jointly investigated and jointly unveiled the mystery of the "Three-Body" world of an unknown extraterrestrial civilization. The story of the game with the Trisolarans who are about to invade.

講述地球基礎科學研究遭遇異常擾動，引發科學界惶恐動盪，納米物理學家汪淼與刑警史強聯手調查，共同揭開了地外未知文明“三體”世界的神秘面紗，並隨全人類一道與即將入侵的三體人展開博弈的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story of an abnormal disturbance in basic scientific research on the earth, which caused panic and turmoil in the scientific community. Nanophysicist Wang Miao and criminal policeman Shi Qiang jointly investigated and jointly unveiled the mystery of the "Three-Body" world of an unknown extraterrestrial civilization. The story of the game with the Trisolarans who are about to invade.

跟着是啫喱隊接受甜品公主的任務，要利用「神奇地壺」收集香蕉和香芋雪糕。兩位隊員均一擊即中，迅速完成任務，「加碼」挑戰啤梨，能否再下一城？來到「下午茶時間」，雙方要鬥快從一堆食物中，找出圖片中所示，再把它們放回相應的下午茶層架中。大家卻眼花撩亂，用上不少時間尋找所需食物，完成時間亦非常接近，勝負如何？另外，「玩轉STEAM樂園」會大玩有趣的泡泡實驗。
花輪同學因遺失了小提琴盒的鎖匙而愁眉不展，小渚自動請纓替他尋找鎖匙。本來打算事不關己的小丸子也被迫一起尋找。在寒冬的一天，小丸子因貪玩而導致右腳長了凍瘡。為免被媽媽責怪，小丸子隱瞞此事。

要體驗空氣的流動，大家可從生活中找到例子，如屋內悶熱時，大家將窗戶打開，讓清風吹入。玩竹蜻蜓時，就是根據白努力原理，當旋轉時，蜻蜓翼上方的空氣流速增加，氣壓會下降，因為蜻蜓翼下方的氣壓較上方高，於是就會產生向上升動力。連直昇機也是根據此原理製造。香港樓宇密度高，病毒隨空氣傳播，根據資料顯示，2003年SARS造成一幢住宅大廈的居民集體染病，煙囪效應就是其中一個因素。究竟煙囪效應會做成空氣怎樣流動？
大雄去釣魚遺下了水桶，怎料媽媽急著要用，多啦A夢遂拿出「失物釣魚池」去把水桶釣回來。小夫代親戚照顧大狗，四處向人炫耀，大雄感到不忿，便在多啦A夢的幫助下從非洲抓來了一頭獅子作寵物。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
跟着是啫喱隊接受甜品公主的任務，要利用「神奇地壺」收集香蕉和香芋雪糕。兩位隊員均一擊即中，迅速完成任務，「加碼」挑戰啤梨，能否再下一城？來到「下午茶時間」，雙方要鬥快從一堆食物中，找出圖片中所示，再把它們放回相應的下午茶層架中。大家卻眼花撩亂，用上不少時間尋找所需食物，完成時間亦非常接近，勝負如何？另外，「玩轉STEAM樂園」會大玩有趣的泡泡實驗。

這集「Kids’ Notes」請到各位小朋友熟悉的文生爸爸、玲玲姐姐和「提子」，介紹適合一家大小參與的防騙活動資訊。提子主題親子嘉年華將會舉行，節目率先預告精彩活動與場地打卡位。一本關於提子的繪本，以簡單易明的插圖、文字帶出防騙故事，小朋友屆時也可到嘉年華現場聽故事。首個以提子為主題的無人機大匯演亦是活動重點之一，小朋友記得留意細節！至於「親子小教煮」，有Kimmy媽咪教煮「韓式卡邦尼年糕」。
在感冒流行的季節，並未患上感冒的小丸子，為了不跑馬拉松而希望被傳染感冒。姐姐以零用錢買了一瓶高價的洗髮水。小丸子不但擅自取用，更慷他人之慨把洗髮水分了一些給小玉。姐姐知道之後十分氣憤。

光線由一種物質進入另一種物質時，光線的方向及速度都會改變，稱為折射。利用折射原理，可以做出有趣的實驗。例如：水中一個硬幣，可以由一個變成兩個，這是因為空氣和水的密度不同，改變部分光線行走方向，造成折射。人在杯前觀察，就會同時看到接近水面位置的硬幣虛像和在杯底的實物。同樣道理，Master Joe及AI會教大家令杯在水中消失和自製放大鏡的實驗。
多啦A夢嘗試用「細菌製造機」創造出用水合成豆沙包的細菌不果，過程中卻產生大量效果各異的細菌。大雄用「時空轉換機」把家裡帶到18世紀法國，媽媽不知就裡出了門，更被法國國王帶入宮中。

光線由一種物質進入另一種物質時，光線的方向及速度都會改變，稱為折射。利用折射原理，可以做出有趣的實驗。例如：水中一個硬幣，可以由一個變成兩個，這是因為空氣和水的密度不同，改變部分光線行走方向，造成折射。人在杯前觀察，就會同時看到接近水面位置的硬幣虛像和在杯底的實物。同樣道理，Master Joe及AI會教大家令杯在水中消失和自製放大鏡的實驗。
多啦A夢嘗試用「細菌製造機」創造出用水合成豆沙包的細菌不果，過程中卻產生大量效果各異的細菌。大雄用「時空轉換機」把家裡帶到18世紀法國，媽媽不知就裡出了門，更被法國國王帶入宮中。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

光線由一種物質進入另一種物質時，光線的方向及速度都會改變，稱為折射。利用折射原理，可以做出有趣的實驗。例如：水中一個硬幣，可以由一個變成兩個，這是因為空氣和水的密度不同，改變部分光線行走方向，造成折射。人在杯前觀察，就會同時看到接近水面位置的硬幣虛像和在杯底的實物。同樣道理，Master Joe及AI會教大家令杯在水中消失和自製放大鏡的實驗。
多啦A夢嘗試用「細菌製造機」創造出用水合成豆沙包的細菌不果，過程中卻產生大量效果各異的細菌。大雄用「時空轉換機」把家裡帶到18世紀法國，媽媽不知就裡出了門，更被法國國王帶入宮中。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
這集「Kids’ Notes」請到各位小朋友熟悉的文生爸爸、玲玲姐姐和「提子」，介紹適合一家大小參與的防騙活動資訊。提子主題親子嘉年華將會舉行，節目率先預告精彩活動與場地打卡位。一本關於提子的繪本，以簡單易明的插圖、文字帶出防騙故事，小朋友屆時也可到嘉年華現場聽故事。首個以提子為主題的無人機大匯演亦是活動重點之一，小朋友記得留意細節！至於「親子小教煮」，有Kimmy媽咪教煮「韓式卡邦尼年糕」。

本集節目請來香港羽毛球總會教練廖國華和學員到場，為大家示範殺球技術、接殺球步法，以及網前球、挑高球的正確姿勢及打法。教練更會利用比賽片段作為教材，讓大家可以透過專業比賽學得更多羽毛球技術。「Badminton識多D」介紹羽毛球知識。羽毛球是最快速的球類運動，教練也會講解羽毛球的計分方法。在「羽毛一族Sure Win」中，教練會利用所教的技巧來考驗主持及小朋友。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
觀眾投票結果出爐，五人獲得相同票數，結果要互相投票決定。米露琪努力搏取大家好感，最終高票當選，但此時喵姆卻提出異議，並指控米露琪惡意賣萌，大家於是召開法庭，對米露琪進行審判。

偉豪、寶兒與嘉賓吳若希輪流跟四歲乖乖仔嬉戲，只見他們相處融洽，男孩亦坐定定吃食物，似乎想不到其爸爸遇到甚麼湊仔難題……偉豪在滑梯底守候，男孩竟不願滑下來？若希陪玩不久便覺累，輕鬆坐着指揮，偉豪夫婦稱「學到嘢」！原來男孩會盲目跟從指令，眾人嘗試扭轉其錯誤想法，惟男孩一見到紅豆就怕怕……若希藉身教助其突破瀡滑梯關口，卻忽問他較喜歡爸爸或媽媽，答案好殘忍！此外，寶怡玩「食字」妙答小朋友對身上有痣的疑問。

遇上欠耐性的六歲女孩，嘉賓森美扮唔識玩層層疊來引她注意，合力向疊高六層目標進發，偉豪竟在旁搞破壞？女孩不想坐定定拼圖，森美設法讓她就範，卻不慎弄跌其手工作品，一臉驚慌……做功課亦是育兒煩惱，藝人們要引導女孩寫毛筆字，難度可想而知！森美看穿女孩耐性將耗盡，即呼喚偉豪夫婦接手，怎料偉豪竟提出代筆，專家直言是壞榜樣！女孩被指用餐時有不少壞習慣，這次拍攝卻判若兩人？專家建議可配合小孩性情，藉遊戲給予教導。

遇上欠耐性的六歲女孩，嘉賓森美扮唔識玩層層疊來引她注意，合力向疊高六層目標進發，偉豪竟在旁搞破壞？女孩不想坐定定拼圖，森美設法讓她就範，卻不慎弄跌其手工作品，一臉驚慌……做功課亦是育兒煩惱，藝人們要引導女孩寫毛筆字，難度可想而知！森美看穿女孩耐性將耗盡，即呼喚偉豪夫婦接手，怎料偉豪竟提出代筆，專家直言是壞榜樣！女孩被指用餐時有不少壞習慣，這次拍攝卻判若兩人？專家建議可配合小孩性情，藉遊戲給予教導。
本集節目請來香港羽毛球總會教練廖國華和學員到場，為大家示範殺球技術、接殺球步法，以及網前球、挑高球的正確姿勢及打法。教練更會利用比賽片段作為教材，讓大家可以透過專業比賽學得更多羽毛球技術。「Badminton識多D」介紹羽毛球知識。羽毛球是最快速的球類運動，教練也會講解羽毛球的計分方法。在「羽毛一族Sure Win」中，教練會利用所教的技巧來考驗主持及小朋友。

本集節目請來香港羽毛球總會教練廖國華和學員到場，為大家示範殺球技術、接殺球步法，以及網前球、挑高球的正確姿勢及打法。教練更會利用比賽片段作為教材，讓大家可以透過專業比賽學得更多羽毛球技術。「Badminton識多D」介紹羽毛球知識。羽毛球是最快速的球類運動，教練也會講解羽毛球的計分方法。在「羽毛一族Sure Win」中，教練會利用所教的技巧來考驗主持及小朋友。

環保玩具設計師與現場小朋友一同大合奏，為Sherman姐姐輕唱《Hands Up》主題曲作伴奏。原來大家所用的都是「環保樂器」，孩子更可於家長引導下輕易造出來。只要略施技巧，樹枝、瓶蓋變搖鈴；一條弦線可奏出結他音韻？一支飲管「剪」成色士風，更可隨時吹奏。嘉賓亦帶來經過多番嘗試才「研發」成功的十字劍球，製作環保玩具背後有何故事？另外，文生爸爸亦善用紙巾筒、顏色紙等材料，自製一隻「扯線木偶小狗」玩具。
小丸子想帶爺爺去溫泉，因此開始了儲錢。但小丸子總是經不起誘惑，把儲了的錢花掉。為了應對媽媽的斥責，小丸子想出了一些招數。後來小丸子從濱治處學了一些新招數，並準備學以致用。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
水向下流是自然定律，其實，要令水倒轉向上並非難事，只要水壓大過地心吸力，就可以做到水向上噴的效果，噴水池就是一例。虹吸原理亦可以令水向上流，日常生活中，魚缸換水和抽水馬桶都運用到虹吸原理，虹吸原理與氣壓及液壓有什麼關係？有什麼條件才會產生虹吸原理？
大雄向多啦A夢借來「多用途護身符」，藉提升財運獲得意外之財，繼而嘗試催谷桃花運與靜香更進一步。大雄想知道自己會收到什麼聖誕禮物，多啦A夢於是借他「時間捲軸」，讓他可以跳到未來。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

美國的佛羅里達州，每年都舉行一個水下音樂會，且聽主持們介紹相關資訊。陳逸嵐、李衍蔓登上這次「My Little Show」的表演舞台，帶來動作整齊的雙人舞，可見她們花了不少時間排練。舞蹈中還加入了側手翻、一字馬等高難度動作，精彩表演獲得大家的熱烈掌聲。另外，「親子小教煮」環節，會有「酥皮蘑菇忌廉湯」的製作示範。

講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
美國的佛羅里達州，每年都舉行一個水下音樂會，且聽主持們介紹相關資訊。陳逸嵐、李衍蔓登上這次「My Little Show」的表演舞台，帶來動作整齊的雙人舞，可見她們花了不少時間排練。舞蹈中還加入了側手翻、一字馬等高難度動作，精彩表演獲得大家的熱烈掌聲。另外，「親子小教煮」環節，會有「酥皮蘑菇忌廉湯」的製作示範。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored music bubbles to pink which threatens to make everything look and sound the same! When the other kids realize what Rita has set in motion they must work furiously to restore the natural diversity of Jammbo before it becomes a big, boring, barren pink wasteland!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Goomo falls asleep in the jellyberry grove.Nearby, King tries to open his soda bottle with a ridiculously powerful machine that ends up knocking over the jellyberry trees! Goomo wakes among the ruins horrified! He convinces himself that he is to blame! It’s up to Bello and Mina to gather clues that get the King to take responsibility for his actions and clear Goomo’s confused mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mina invents a giant robot for changing light bulbs on Jammbo. Bello thinks the robot should be made to defend Jammbo from invaders! Without Mina’s knowledge, he modifies “Jammbobot” causing it to malfunction and rampage through the planet. Bello discovers the meaning behind the words “don’t touch my stuff!”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Queen’s Song Fruit are being stolen from the royal garden.It’s up to the detective duo of Jammboman and Sidekickman to solve this crime. Everyone is a suspect. Their listening skills and teamwork help them catch the fruit filcher. It’s quite a surprise---even to the thief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: During teatime, Rita loses track of Princess. She searches Jammbo in a frantic frenzy but fails to find her best friend. Bello sees Rita’s upset. He vows to make her have so much fun, that she’ll forget Princess. And he does! But, when Princess reappears, it’s Bello who feels friendless.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But, soon the fun and games are replaced by games that make only Rita happy. The tiny Queen must realize how the power is going to her head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds have them all thinking a monster is stalking them!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and dangerous heights begins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodos work hard to set things right, but without an informed boss disaster looms. Bello must learn, and fast, that preparation is the key to performing any job correctly!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will make her a loser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits and restore Jammbo’s jelly-good health. In the process they recycle their garbage into something they can all enjoy.

After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisible weirdness. They come up with an experiment of their own to see how much the scientist likes being tested!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles! And if the dodos stop, Jammbo has no music. If there’s no music, the planet freezes! Yikes! It’s up to the boys to find the ghost, put an end to the spookiness and save the ever-musical Jammbo!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored music bubbles to pink which threatens to make everything look and sound the same! When the other kids realize what Rita has set in motion they must work furiously to restore the natural diversity of Jammbo before it becomes a big, boring, barren pink wasteland!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. epg.programme_title_en: Monkey Saint in the Under Sea Castle
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐僧四師徒往取西經，途中唐僧被白鼠精施計擄走，孫悟空為救唐僧，向東海龍王借定風珠，被三太子所拒，空強行搶珠。空發現白鼠精尊李靖為父，向玉帝告狀指靖縱容親女作惡，靖下凡收妖，唐僧獲救，與空等人繼續上路。
李大偉與羅翠玲將新屋的一個房間租予楊志華。一次，玲代華修補褲子，偉看見感不悅。其後偉更誤會兩人有姦情，決意離婚，成全二人。當偉得知真相，欲阻止玲與華成婚，於結婚當日，偉發現新娘是華的女友，才知被戲弄。
李浩清為了得到工作，答應把妻子何素梅剛誕下的兒子送給彼德。德把孩子交給情人蓮娜，娜向富商汪瑞祥謊稱孩子是兩人所生，以騙取金錢。德與娜打算挾帶私逃，被祥撞破；祥把孩子交還梅，但梅因生計，決把孩子送予祥。
甘慧生因天生三眼遭父遺棄，長大後隨莊玉英學藝。生邂逅少女溫明珠，後珠遭尤霸天擄去，生誤會是甘卓雄所為，於是英與甘妻程秋雲激戰，雲被打傷。雲偶然救出珠，並得知一切真相。英偕生往救雲後，生喜與雄、雲相認。

武松成打虎英雄後，回家探望兄長大郎，竟遭兄嫂潘金蓮挑逗，松直斥其非，憤而離去。多日後，松驚聞大郎患了急病而死，但後得悉另有內情，原來大郎乃遭蓮及其姦夫西門慶所害，他遂殺掉兩人為兄報仇，再自首被判充軍。
天蓬元帥犯天條被貶下凡，投胎為半人半豬的豬八戒。八戒奉命隨唐三藏取西經，但等待三藏出現期間，愛上高小姐，更幻化俊男與她成親。婚後八戒原形畢露，鬧得翻天覆地，幸三藏與孫悟空來到收拾八戒，後一同往取西經。
崔琼珍遵從父母遺訓照顧弟妹，專注工作。其弟妹擔心珍嫁杏無期，介紹趙福根給珍認識。珍與根一見傾慕，共墮愛河。珍暗中助根發展事業，根得悉後忿而辭職，惟根不忍珍傷心，兩人和好。各人也覓得如花美眷，皆大歡喜。
阿蓮丈夫麥俊雄到香港謀生，蓮與家姑為避惡霸，到港尋找雄不果。雄與家人失去聯絡，從鄉里處聽聞全家已葬身火海，十分傷心，幸得老闆千金苗婉貞安慰及青睞。雄與貞訂婚當晚，雄與家人重逢，貞自願退婚，雄與蓮團聚。
黑璇風行俠仗義救人，巧遇打抱不平的一丈紅父女，三人合力救出民女。紅父女賣藝，藍九少看上紅，挾持其父逼她下嫁，紅施計拖延。九少強搶金玉蘭，紅暗中助黑璇風救出蘭，九少追至，紅報官讓九少伏法，成功救出父親。

孿生兄妹文夢瑚、文秋雲與謝家兄妹承恩、小嬌有婚約，雲因故與瑚失散，被乞丐撫養成人。雲潛入謝家偷雞，得知瑚、嬌之事，遂假扮瑚向嬌騙錢，後卻意外與恩歡好，懷孕誕子。雲、瑚終知悉彼此關係，並與恩、嬌成佳偶。
鐵扇公主因牛魔王另結新歡玉面公主，積鬱成病。紅孩兒施計捉唐僧，欲以其肉治母。孫悟空往營救卻不敵，幸觀音出手降伏紅孩兒。玉面趁亂擄走唐僧，牛魔王怒殺玉面。鐵扇救出唐僧，並與牛魔王破鏡重圓，心病不藥而癒。
張家寶誤交損友黑仔源、依華，其妻不滿與寶分居，並將鑽石手鐲交還張母。張母將手鐲藏於椅子裡，豈料華賣掉椅子，輾轉落入陳伯家中。寶、華及源往盜椅，你爭我奪。寶終看清兩人，覺悟前非，幸得妻子原諒，夫妻團圓。
司馬玉兒替師父孫六娘尋回女兒歐陽秋雁，八卦幫幫主伍標卻嫁禍雁殺死梁遠聲的堂兄。兒與雁、聲查明箇中真相後，與聲假投八卦幫，查得白骨鞭可對付標。標識破兒假意投敵，兒、雁合力也不敵標，後聲以白骨鞭把標收拾。
梅伯芹想將女兒梅麗嫁予富家子蔡占臣，惜麗卻鍾情楊納維，在母親同意下，與維結婚。婚後生活貧困，麗只好出外做僕人，未料遇上臣、芹等人，慘被欺侮，麗含淚奪門而去，卻不幸被車撞死。維自責，決獨力苦養三名子女。

趙王垂涎莫如秋之妻崔靜儀美貌，強押回府，迫其改嫁，又派人殺死崔氏一家；儀得趙妃幫助，逃出王府。秋欲向包公告狀，卻誤把狀書交給趙王爪牙而遭拘禁。儀遇包公，包公礙於趙王身分，裝死騙其過府審訊，將其鍘死。
梁小慧獲電影公司垂青，擬邀與影星何俊民拍新戲，惜民拒拍。慧得好友幫助成功游說民接拍電影。民表妹Lily妒忌慧，串同富商Peter迷魂慧，讓民誤會拒與慧合作。後民無意中得知真相，二人冰釋，電影得以續拍。
方翠紅之父生意失敗，紅被繼母賣作舞女，幸得馬正祥相救，兩人成為戀人。雜貨店少東朱佐治看上了紅，他對祥羞辱，又對紅圖謀不軌，祥再次勇救佳人。祥與好友丘六開設雜貨店，得紅與工友們幫忙，成功搶去佐治的生意。
區文立一家因三叔欠債逃去而變得一貧如洗，其後立父雙目失明，立又因病而遭公司辭退，更禍不單行，鄰居失火令一家人無處容身。立妻為籌錢險些被逼賣淫，幸被鄰居陳康所救。最終三叔回來清還債項，區家終可度過難關。

epg.programme_title_en: Adv. of W. F. H., The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬如龍、如虎兄弟與黃飛鴻素有積怨，虎欲對下屬的未婚妻不軌，糾纏間對方竟意外自刺身亡，虎趁機串謀縣官誣陷鴻因姦不遂殺人，鴻被收監。鴻徒弟林世榮等人劫獄，鴻曉以大義。後提督查明真相，嚴懲虎等人。

程夢麟遭二叔陷害，被迫與妻樊采雲分離，改名換姓投軍。雲有孕，被二叔誣衊與人有染，含冤投井不死。六年後，雲子程小麟為雙親申冤，險遭二叔害，幸為程母救。麟向雲父擊鼓鳴冤，遇夢；雲父把奸人治罪，夢一家團圓。

epg.programme_title_en: Night of the Purple Rain, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 林文聲與王石女兒麗儀相戀，並得兩父女照顧和鼓勵。紫燕歌劇團團員張紫燕欣賞聲的才華及志向。石向劇團推薦聲，聲的歌劇《紫色風雨夜》大受歡迎，惜聲成名後移情燕。石離世，聲受到良心責備及反省，決定與儀續前緣。
何業生與張玉琴、楊文樂與顏素莊、胡經牧與沈慕潔，三對夫婦為生活，所做的工作卻並不是自己的專長，弄致笑料百出，誤會重重。其後樂、莊、琴及牧先後因無心工作犯錯而被辭退，幸各人誤打誤撞終得償所願，各展所長。
鏢師高山虎與妻葉潔冰、女兒雲英失散。多年後，虎與英得以相認。英押鏢途中，遇上陸少雄，二人產生誤會，雄用高家獨門武功打敗英。虎往陸家查探高家武功流傳外人之事，豈料竟與冰重逢，並得知事情始末，一家終團聚。

程夢麟遭二叔陷害，被迫與妻樊采雲分離，改名換姓投軍。雲有孕，被二叔誣衊與人有染，含冤投井不死。六年後，雲子程小麟為雙親申冤，險遭二叔害，幸為程母救。麟向雲父擊鼓鳴冤，遇夢；雲父把奸人治罪，夢一家團圓。
何業生與張玉琴、楊文樂與顏素莊、胡經牧與沈慕潔，三對夫婦為生活，所做的工作卻並不是自己的專長，弄致笑料百出，誤會重重。其後樂、莊、琴及牧先後因無心工作犯錯而被辭退，幸各人誤打誤撞終得償所願，各展所長。
鏢師高山虎與妻葉潔冰、女兒雲英失散。多年後，虎與英得以相認。英押鏢途中，遇上陸少雄，二人產生誤會，雄用高家獨門武功打敗英。虎往陸家查探高家武功流傳外人之事，豈料竟與冰重逢，並得知事情始末，一家終團聚。

epg.programme_title_en: Hau Emperor Falls in Love, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛延壽借選秀女歛財，王昭君不肯行賄落選。君唱出怨憤，為漢王聽見，於是懲處壽。壽施計向匈奴王進言，匈奴王逼令漢王交出君，兵臨城下，君無奈出塞和番，並施美人計殺死壽。君自盡，屍首飄回故土，與漢王夢中惜別。
徐淑娟為家貧學生林小明與校長爭執，憤而辭職到孤兒院任院長，而明終被趕出校，淪為街童。娟與表哥李義將街童接到孤兒院，明為救院友致雙腳殘廢。娟答應隨義出國留學，義在歡送會上被孤兒們的歌聲感動，決與娟留下。
朱潤祥見工被騙金錢，於債主孔家的雲吞麵店工作，卻遭同事沙皮狗針對，幸獲店主女兒孔珍妮賞識。何伯壇於隔鄰開設上海麵店，祥亦被他挖角。狗與老千合謀向孔家騙財，幸祥及時阻止，並提議妮與壇合營麵店，和氣生財。
交際花郭綺薇與醫生駱家昭情投意合，薇為昭洗盡鉛華，但昭舅父為撮合其女龐麗華與昭，逼薇退出，薇為昭前途忍痛分手。昭以為薇自甘墮落，當眾羞辱她。華得知其父從中作梗拆散二人，遂告知昭真相，昭與薇冰釋、和好。

南宮正和同情武蕊卿，於燕子箋上賦詩。賈良駒夫婦為霸佔家財，毒殺兄長並嫁禍予卿，妯娌阮珍珠更以燕子箋力證卿與和有私情。卿含冤自盡，和判候斬。卿妹武二蠻施計令駒夫婦自招罪狀，為卿、和雪冤，並與和締結良緣。
張達女兒寶寶常遭繼母碧珍虐打，達撞破珍與術士周錦有染，遭錦丟下古井。寶得亡母顯靈指示救父，於井下拾得夜光杯，意外召出杯仙，與父獲救。杯仙變來酷似寶亡母的寶靈公主作寶繼母，國王懸賞尋女，錦發現公主所在。
王光瑞與女僕珍兒相戀，珍珠胎暗結，瑞卻被王母逼娶表妹為妻。瑞、珍私奔，惜事敗，珍被逐出王府，幸得瑞之表兄李孔翔收留，並栽培珍成為花旦。翔安排珍與瑞合演一場《祭珍妃》，王母被感動，覺悟前非，終成全兩人。
醫生王志明不甘含冤而越獄，並偷了梅海培為母醫病的錢而害他自殺。明良心發現，欲還錢給其妹梅瑛不果，遂與白萍辦診所贖罪。明得知瑛下落後，瑛被王大爺迫還債，幸明救出瑛，並向她坦白一切。明替瑛殺王後自首入獄。
左鑑白夫婦被指殺害四大派掌門，遭武林人士追殺。鑑白夫婦及長子繼白被殺，女兒文娟跳崖，幼子少白則逃出生天，並獲天劍、絕刀傳授武藝。五年後，娟成為劍主，少白與黃榮等人組成金刀幫，追查當年四大掌門被殺真相。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林中人對白家珍藏的「唐門火冊」虎視眈眈,後更揚言要擄劫其女。大俠沈勝衣於是建議以其情人煙飛代白家小姐,並尋出個中玄機...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protectin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情承接上集,唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯,在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞,但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍,叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓,生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星,從此飛黃騰達,但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡,魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上,卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客,再與他們結盟,密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming’s guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kil

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang’s leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to mar

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film is an amusing insider’s look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang’s popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導,為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述,呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒, 由越南逃至澳門;呂於香港出生,可在港居留,乃與李分散;鄭則仕飾呂之叔父,為一幹練警探,即介紹呂加入員警世界,派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害;而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女殺手被組織控制,強逼去殺商界名人石英,險中殺人滅口的陷阱。她不想淪為殺人工具,決心進行報仇大計,故事曲折離奇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a n

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片為邵氏「西遊記」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中,希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大鬧盤絲洞拯救唐僧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother’s Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him!  Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 顧定是太極高手,卻隱藏身份為一名建築工人。當他的女朋友被惡霸強暴後,顧定唯有迫不得已出手讓惡霸受到應有的懲罰,彰顯公義。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家,為奴以埋父骨;其孝心感動了七仙女,便幻成村姑,在六位仙姐下凡暗助下,為董縮減償還工作日,回復自由後,二人回董故家,但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍,若能奪得,必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館,稱霸江湖...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called Swordswomen Two. Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaws first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for acti

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be app

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰,在賭館當巡場;一夜,十虎的徒弟及後人等四人,在賭場相聚時,旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲,把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等,昔日曾把父殺死,以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手,殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人,為父報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who ret

epg.programme_title_en: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people’s livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲,拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他。豈料四人與關雲不打不相識,反成好友。後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲,四人悲憤交集,遂聯手為友復仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agencys young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuans conspiracy leads to Guans death, they unit

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,少年衛虎家遭左景龍、應天與楊剛所洗劫,父母幼弟被殺,姊衛芸被左劫走,頓時家破人亡。虎憤恨萬狀,放火燒毀家園,決心遠走天涯,找尋仇人報復;虎流浪各地,遇隱名大俠士,投拜為師,數年即習藝有成,遂往找仇人;虎抵雞兒鎮,遇弱女香香遭逼為娼,逐出手相助,擊退歹徒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. Wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日本財閥小川,為奪燕姓所有之森林,勾結劣紳關甫淩,屢次對森林主人燕劍光遊說,均被拒絕。小川收買燕家內侄徐千偷取燕老鑰匙,潛入密室,盜取地契。後被燕老發覺,徐千竟將燕老痛毆致死。關甫淩有女月花,與燕家小主人子飛,本有嫁娶之約,燕老死後,但鑑於其父與日人相勾結,國恨家仇,兒女私情無法兼顧,只得示意決絕…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japan

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May ins

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺。事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為“少林五祖”。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to becom

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮花離開虐待她的丈夫後搬進了新公寓。當她準備開展新生活時,卻發現睡覺時總被某些東西咬一口,使她變得睡眠不足和疑神疑鬼,更產生了莫名的恐懼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer moves into a new apartment after leaving her abusive husband. As she starts life anew, something keeps biting her when she sleeps, leading her to be sleep deprived, paranoid and paralyzed with fear of the unseen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer moves into a new apartment after leaving her abusive husband. As she starts life anew, something keeps biting her when she sleeps, leading her to be sleep deprived, paranoid and paralyzed with fear of the unseen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨的阿振在工作中飽受同事的欺凌。當他選擇與由美一起度過生日時,朋友卻驚覺由美竟是一個充氣娃娃。阿振渴望有人陪伴,於是轉向網路,並找到了理想中的女孩米娜。米娜的出現徹底改變了他的生活,然而,當米娜的吸..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely Ah Zhen is bullied by his coworkers. When he spends his birthday with Yumi, his friends shockingly discover that Yumi is an inflatable doll. Seeking companionship, Ah Zhen turns to the internet and finds his ideal girl Mina. Her arrival transforms his life but a series of unexpected events unfold as her identity as a vampire is revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的聖山村發生了一系列神秘事件,原本該下葬的屍體突然復活,而且拔足狂跑。全村馬上展開追查行動,但這時村中惡霸卻意外死亡,村長也失蹤。於是警察接手調查,但當謎底快要解開時,村幹部卻又有驚天大發現。到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的聖山村發生了一系列神秘事件,原本該下葬的屍體突然復活,而且拔足狂跑。全村馬上展開追查行動,但這時村中惡霸卻意外死亡,村長也失蹤。於是警察接手調查,但當謎底快要解開時,村幹部卻又有驚天大發現。到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮花離開虐待她的丈夫後搬進了新公寓。當她準備開展新生活時,卻發現睡覺時總被某些東西咬一口,使她變得睡眠不足和疑神疑鬼,更產生了莫名的恐懼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer moves into a new apartment after leaving her abusive husband. As she starts life anew, something keeps biting her when she sleeps, leading her to be sleep deprived, paranoid and paralyzed with fear of the unseen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。

從小與父親疏遠的鄭輝,意外穿越回了八十年代,在與年輕時的父親一同經歷了許多事後,慢慢走進了陌生父親的內心,明白了工作之間並無尊卑之分,每個普通人都有著平凡而偉大的夢想。
青年二子待業在家,整天無所事事。哥們麻杆聞得居委會有意讓他們幾個待業青年合夥承包一家小客店,趕來和二子商量。二子覺得這個主意不錯,於是和麻杆開始“招兵買馬,他們找來了失業在家的女生英子、父母都不在了的大虎和不堪忍受繼父虐待的小豆。在二子父..
該片描寫了縣委書記--焦裕祿同志,在蘭考縣任職期間,抱重病帶領全縣人民群眾戰天鬥地,克己奉公,甘當人民公僕,為改變蘭考面貌,為黨的事業謳心瀝血,鞠躬盡瘁的動人故事。
娛樂無極影視公司的製片人翁小淳曾經是電視圈裡的知名人物。他一手操辦起來的名牌直播欄目《娛樂跑馬場》一直以來都是順平市電視臺的收視王牌,翁小淳也一度成為了順平電視臺的紅人。但10年的時間似乎耗盡了觀眾對《娛樂跑馬場》的耐心,也耗盡了翁小淳的才..
黃河大災,八十萬兩賑災銀卻不翼而飛!綠林三十八寨意外捲入,被誣陷成為劫掠賑災銀的不法之徒!俠捕蕭長風臨危受命,追查災銀下落,讓一干國之碩鼠伏法!讓綠林好漢塵緣昭雪!

包工頭有才,受人委託,從看守所接走了陝西老鄉大愣。
有才聽說大愣幫人要賬成功率很高,就問大愣能不能幫他要賬,大愣聽了很惱火,因為他就是幫人要賬才進去的。
大愣的態度讓有才很難堪,也有些生氣。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu Reeves stars in 47 Ronin, an epic fantasy where an outcast joins samurai on a quest for vengeance and honor against a ruthless overlord in ancient Japan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球轟動的系列持續延燒。凱妮絲(珍妮佛·勞倫斯 飾)在摧毀飢餓遊戲後倖存下來,並與第13區聯手,挺身對抗殘暴的史諾總統(唐納·蘇德蘭 飾)。革命的火焰已被點燃,帕納姆的命運正面臨最關鍵的一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide phenomenon continues. Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) has survived and destroyed the Hunger Games, and now rises with District 13 to fight against President Snow (Donald Sutherland).

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Pitch Black*, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night.

Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud

epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

Now, the police must race to unravel the mystery and stop the killings before panic consumes the city.

Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

Join Indonesian famous models Patricia and Chika as they explore the citys hidden gems and vibrant scenes, immersing themselves in amazing contrasts and trendy vibes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前特警隊長東谷在任務中罹患永久性失明,之後更被脅迫要承擔任務失敗的責任。幸好東谷在女兒的陪伴下逐漸走出陰霾,並開始適應黑暗的世界。可是曾經的宿敵再度出現,令女兒陷入危險之中。東谷為救女兒,展開了一場生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的夏季短捉,時間緊迫- 任何時候都是戰鬥的好時機.宏大的北方為野牛,禿鷹和北極熊提供了動物王國中激戰的戰場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Canada, where summer is short and time is tight – any time is the right time to fight. The mighty North provides the setting for bison, bald eagles, and polar bears to wage some of the most heavy-duty fighting in the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的塞德堡山脈是一片多年來由風,水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌.這些壯觀的山峰是眾多不同植物和動物的家.但這裡亦有些看不見的東西,墊伏在陰暗處伺機攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rocky landscape, carved over eons by wind, water and fire, these are the Cederberg Mountains of South Africa. These imposing peaks are home to an incredible diversity of plants and animals. But there are some here that remain unseen, lurking in ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷有一片烏木樹林,是一群狒狒的家園.但這裡存在著危險 - 與其他掠食者不同,同為居民的獵豹具有足夠的強大和敏捷性來爬樹.牠不是容易逃避的敵人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here – the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. Hes not an easy foe to elude.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧安瓜谷的平原和林地住著最狂野和最無情的動物,捕食者和獵物間的對決日以繼夜進行著.對於稱它為家的動物來說,每天都要靠戰鬥生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighborhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, its a daily battle to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園.牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護.挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents. They are not your typical rats or squirrels - these giants are the size of sheep!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷有一片烏木樹林,是一群狒狒的家園.但這裡存在著危險 - 與其他掠食者不同,同為居民的獵豹具有足夠的強大和敏捷性來爬樹.牠不是容易逃避的敵人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here – the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. Hes not an easy foe to elude.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧安瓜谷的平原和林地住著最狂野和最無情的動物,捕食者和獵物間的對決日以繼夜進行著.對於稱它為家的動物來說,每天都要靠戰鬥生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighborhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, its a daily battle to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園.牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護.挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents. They are not your typical rats or squirrels - these giants are the size of sheep!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由亞馬遜到安第斯山脈,南美洲有著一些美景. 從草原上吵鬧的原駝,到灘頭上擠擁的海鬣蜥,再到偷掉居所的寄居蟹,住屋的需求引發很多衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Amazon to the Andes, South America has some beautiful scenery. From guanacos sparring over grassland, to marine iguanas head-butting over a beachhead, to home-stealing hermit crabs, the quest for real estate causes a lot of conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷有一片烏木樹林,是一群狒狒的家園.但這裡存在著危險 - 與其他掠食者不同,同為居民的獵豹具有足夠的強大和敏捷性來爬樹.牠不是容易逃避的敵人.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighborhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, its a daily battle to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟團隊一起度過忙碌的一天,他們釋放已康復的蟒蛇,教穿山甲如何狩獵,並包抄一群長尾猴.與夏洛特博士一起尋找失蹤的猛禽,而阿曼達博士則幫助一隻被偷獵者狗隻蹂躪的假面野豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crush a busy day with the team as they release rehabbed pythons, teach a pangolin how to hunt, and round up a troop of vervet monkeys. Search for a missing bird of prey with Dr. Charlotte, while Dr. Amanda helps a bushpig savaged by poachers dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達博士取下黑馬羚的追蹤頸圈時發生緊急情況需要處理,觀察動物護理團隊幫助一隻長滿跳蚤的長尾猴嬰兒尋找新媽媽.釋放兩隻藪貓孤兒,跟隨20隻黃狒狒進入牠們的新圍欄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tackle an emergency when Dr. Amanda removes a sable antelopes tracking collar, and see the animal-care team help a flea-riddled baby vervet monkey find a new mom. Free two orphaned serval cats and follow 20 yellow baboons into their new enclosure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年旱季,隨著洪水消失,潘塔納爾濕地的草原就成為許多物種的家:巨型食蟻獸,鬃狼和更大的品種 - 南美洲最大的鳥類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year in the dry season, as the floodwaters disappear, the grasslands of the Pantanal are home to many species: giant anteaters, maned wolves and the greater rheas- the largest bird in South America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年旱季,隨著洪水消失,潘塔納爾濕地的草原就成為許多物種的家:巨型食蟻獸,鬃狼和更大的品種 - 南美洲最大的鳥類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year in the dry season, as the floodwaters disappear, the grasslands of the Pantanal are home to many species: giant anteaters, maned wolves and the greater rheas- the largest bird in South America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷有一片烏木樹林,是一群狒狒的家園.但這裡存在著危險 - 與其他掠食者不同,同為居民的獵豹具有足夠的強大和敏捷性來爬樹.牠不是容易逃避的敵人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here – the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. Hes not an easy foe to elude.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧安瓜谷的平原和林地住著最狂野和最無情的動物,捕食者和獵物間的對決日以繼夜進行著.對於稱它為家的動物來說,每天都要靠戰鬥生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighborhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, its a daily battle to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟團隊一起度過忙碌的一天,他們釋放已康復的蟒蛇,教穿山甲如何狩獵,並包抄一群長尾猴.與夏洛特博士一起尋找失蹤的猛禽,而阿曼達博士則幫助一隻被偷獵者狗隻蹂躪的假面野豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crush a busy day with the team as they release rehabbed pythons, teach a pangolin how to hunt, and round up a troop of vervet monkeys. Search for a missing bird of prey with Dr. Charlotte, while Dr. Amanda helps a bushpig savaged by poachers dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達博士取下黑馬羚的追蹤頸圈時發生緊急情況需要處理,觀察動物護理團隊幫助一隻長滿跳蚤的長尾猴嬰兒尋找新媽媽.釋放兩隻藪貓孤兒,跟隨20隻黃狒狒進入牠們的新圍欄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tackle an emergency when Dr. Amanda removes a sable antelopes tracking collar, and see the animal-care team help a flea-riddled baby vervet monkey find a new mom. Free two orphaned serval cats and follow 20 yellow baboons into their new enclosure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現實中決鬥的龍,巨型相撲甲蟲,街頭毆鬥的猴子和扮演山之王的海龜- 處於另一隻海龜之上,東南亞擁有繁多的野生動物戰士.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With real-life dueling dragons, giant sumo-wrestling beetles, street-fighting monkeys, and sea turtles that play king of the hill – on top of another sea turtle, Southeast Asia boasts a wide range of wildlife warriors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟團隊一起度過忙碌的一天,他們釋放已康復的蟒蛇,教穿山甲如何狩獵,並包抄一群長尾猴.與夏洛特博士一起尋找失蹤的猛禽,而阿曼達博士則幫助一隻被偷獵者狗隻蹂躪的假面野豬.
